topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I can hardly believe my eyes when I open the package on my desk. Nestled among the tissue paper is a beautifully bound volume of poems, a creation I remember helping this student refine during countless after-school sessions. The weight of it, the craftsmanship, is a testament to the growth I’ve witnessed. Attached is a card, simple and elegant, with a note that reads, “Thank you for the words and the world they opened.” Each word a reminder of the moments we shared, the seeds of curiosity we planted. I run my fingers over the book’s cover, a rush of energy coursing through me. It’s a legacy, a small piece of the future shaped by the lessons of the past, and the promise of what lies ahead.
